description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PdfAttributesBase' for PDF attribute objects within the PdfSharp library. It includes constructors, a nested 'Keys' class containing definitions for key identifiers like '/O', and inherits from 'PdfDictionary'.

classes.name: PdfAttributesBase
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for PDF attribute objects, providing constructors and a nested Keys class for attribute keys.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Nested class defining key constants for the attribute dictionary, such as '/O'.

methods.name: PdfAttributesBase(PdfDocument)
methods.description: Constructor with a PdfDocument parameter, invoked when the object is owned by a document.
